description: Nathan Bridger returns from retirement to command the exploratory submarine SeaQuest, balancing UEO politics with scientific discovery, undersea colonies, environmental crises and first contact with mysteries hidden beneath the oceans.

s01e01-02.description: Retired designer Nathan Bridger reluctantly takes command of SeaQuest when its former captain turns pirate and threatens the new UEO order.

s01e03.description: A mass murderer is accidentally brought aboard SeaQuest and escapes after revealing that a lethal toxin is thawing somewhere inside the ship.

s01e04.description: A pathogen recovered from a sunken space station infects the crew while a hostile submarine arrives to erase evidence of the experiment.

s01e05.description: SeaQuest is ordered to seal an abandoned munitions depot but discovers a group of children still living inside the dangerous facility.

s01e06.description: Darwin becomes critically ill after investigating a deep-sea black smoker, forcing Bridger to choose between keeping his companion and setting him free.

s01e07.description: The discovery of the lost Library of Alexandria triggers an international dispute that Bridger must defuse before the site is destroyed.

s01e08.description: Krieg discovers mysterious glowing stones in the Tonga Trench, and the prospect of wealth proves nearly as dangerous as the unknown creature guarding them.

s01e09.description: A century-old sunken ship appears to be haunted, and one of its spirits takes possession of Dr. Westphalen.

s01e10.description: A hurricane strands several crew members on the surface while the damaged SeaQuest races to rescue children trapped in a sunken submarine.

s01e11.description: A breakdown forces Krieg to deal with a ruthless black-market trader whose past is tied to Bridger and whose outsider status intrigues Lucas.

s01e12.description: A visit to an undersea mining colony reveals a community ruled like the Old West, with workers desperate for SeaQuest to challenge the men controlling them.

s01e13.description: Lucas visits a colony of young computer prodigies and is drawn into a hacking scheme that manipulates global finances for reasons more complicated than profit.

s01e14.description: The first crewed Mars mission crashes into the ocean on its return, beginning a race between SeaQuest and a hostile power to recover the astronauts.

s01e15.description: With most of the crew evacuated for an experiment, environmental extremists seize the unusually vulnerable SeaQuest.

s01e16.description: A scientific buoy crashes on an island where treasure hunters mistake the UEO recovery effort for an attempt to steal their hoped-for fortune.

s01e17.description: Bridger refuses orders to destroy an environmental radical attacking whaling ships, putting his command of SeaQuest on the line.

s01e18.description: Lucas accompanies UEO leaders to a conference and becomes a hostage when the gathering is seized by attackers.

s01e19.description: Lucas and Hitchcock enter a cutting-edge submersible competition, but a rival steals their prototype after opening fire during a test.

s01e20.description: Westphalen is captured by a deposed dictator who wants trained dolphins for military use, while his son's bond with the animals creates an unexpected opening.

s01e21.description: Ford's sighting of a supposed mermaid leads him to a scientist conducting disturbing experiments on human adaptation to the sea.

s01e22.description: SeaQuest discovers a million-year-old alien vessel embedded beneath the ocean and learns that the away team may not be alone inside it.

s01e23.description: SeaQuest is tricked into firing on a refugee ship, sending Ford and the Westphalens into hostile territory while they try to save the surviving children.

s01e24.description: As SeaQuest's tour ends, a catastrophic fracture beneath an ocean power plant threatens the planet and forces Bridger to consider sacrificing the ship.
